prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Acorn Hand replacement voucher ticket, voucher-hoard.png. The reference sheet holds ten painted ticket stubs for a cosy storybook card game. Paint ONE new ticket to replace the fourth one (top row fourth from left, brown tipped-pot ticket). Match the other nine exactly in shape, size proportions, paper, painting style and upper-left warm lighting. Output ONE landscape PNG about 4:3, truly transparent background alpha zero, ticket centred with a small transparent margin all round. No text, numbers, letters, currency glyphs or printed symbols anywhere. Ticket: thick cream card stock washed in LIGHT walnut-tan, a HALF-ROUND INWARD NOTCH cut from the middle of EACH short end, dotted perforation line about three-quarters across, narrow right stub COMPLETELY PLAIN for the game to print the price. Same dark outline and soft paper texture as reference tickets. Emblem ONLY on larger left part: a small bright RED SQUIRREL with a big bushy curled tail, standing UPRIGHT, proudly hugging a tall plump TERRACOTTA CLAY JAR filled to the brim with ACORNS, a little heap of acorns crowned on top. Both upright, nothing tipped or spilling. Squirrel and jar fill most of left part's height but stay COMPLETELY WITHIN ticket edges with a clearly visible paper gap at top, bottom, left edge and before perforation. Bright orange squirrel and terracotta jar stand out against LIGHT TAN ticket. Must read at 150 pixels wide as a squirrel guarding its stash of nuts. Reference image is STYLE reference only; do not output the entire sheet or any other ticket.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: nuts.png game currency atlas for Acorn Hand, cosy woodland storybook poker. Reference table.png and vouchers.png are STYLE and acorn subject references only. Paint our own ACORN tokens to replace a chestnut emoji. Sheet: truly transparent PNG alpha zero, EXACTLY 3 columns x 1 row of equal SQUARE cells, overall aspect 3:1, one acorn centred in EACH cell filling about 75% cell height, nothing touching any cell edge, generous transparent gutters. NO text, numbers, letters, coins, frames, ground shadows, matte or glow. Acorn: plump round-bottomed nut warm golden BROWN with a distinctly darker cross-hatched CAP and SHORT STALK on top. Crosshatching only a FEW BOLD strokes; instantly readable at 16px, bold simple silhouette. Match acorns in attached table painting. Storybook gouache, warm upper-left lantern light, one soft highlight on nut, one lower-right shade, clean dark-brown outline. The SAME acorn in three cells, LEFT TO RIGHT: (1) UPRIGHT, (2) tilted about 15 degrees LEFT, (3) tilted about 15 degrees RIGHT. Exactly same size, colours, lighting. Only the three isolated tokens, not a table scene. Equal square cells and exact 3:1 sheet ratio.

No baked numbers; no text, letters, symbols, multiplication sign, labels or inscriptions. No additional ornaments, no hanging ropes, no supports, no drop shadows/glow/matte outside the isolated plaques.
